chapter.v:
Judge me,
O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

For thou
art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

Oh send
out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.

Then will
I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.

Why art
thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who is the help of my countenance, and my God.
